_doc: Canonical fixtures cherry-picked from Phase 2.4 batches 10/11. Each fixture is one Test Cases sheet row that was deeply analyzed via explore agent and committed to torch_xpu_ops_issues.xlsx cols 17/18. The regression test re-asks the skill to classify the same row and verifies the verdict + that the explanation contains key tokens that prove the deep-analysis path executed.
